title: Robot arm
description: Tap a block to have a toy robot arm pick it up, then tap the bench or another block to set it down or stack it. Left alone, it sorts the painted blocks into a tower of each colour, then scatters a few to sort again. The CPU solves its joints with cyclic coordinate descent using wgpu-matrix, runs each task as a machine from machines.run and pushes blocks out of the gripper's way. Instances draw @typegpu/kit/geometry shapes, their oak planks, pegboard and painted grain from material hooks, in a dim workshop under a desk lamp. The lamp is a spot light whose shadow an attenuation hook samples across the bulb so its edges soften, ambient occlusion from a depth prepass darkens the seams between blocks, and FXAA smooths the finished frame.
line: A toy arm sorting painted blocks into towers on a workbench, its joints solved with wgpu-matrix.
hint: point at the bench · drag to orbit · wheel to zoom
